newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Trencor lifts half year shr, div flat.
newsitem.headline: Trencor lifts half year shr, div flat.

text.p: NOTE - Analysts polled by Reuters forecast earnings rising to between 51.9 and 72 cents, with consensus at 60.3. The half year dividend was forecast at between 12 and 14 cents a share.
NOTE - Shareholders will be offered a capitalisation share award in lieu of the dividend in the ratio of 0.475248 shares for every existing Trencor share held.

The group said that plans to increase production and install the latest technology were well advanced. The container industry continued to experience cyclical business conditions but would continue to offer attractive long-term returns.
It said it had formed a financial services company, Trencoro, in co-operation with Coronation Holdings Ltd to tap the potential of financing-related activities.
